shared_elements: row/register of figures aligned on a groundline
low-relief carving of a scene on a flat rectangular panel
horizontal framing band at top of the field
justification: Both show a horizontal register of upright human figures in profile standing on a common groundline within a framed rectangular relief field, which is a real but fairly generic correspondence. They differ sharply in everything specific: A is dominated by a large block of repeated script signs beneath a small figural scene with a winged emblem and raised-arm gestures, while B has no writing but a procession of tribute-bearers leading a two-humped animal between rosette borders.
